question: Have development seeds 200-209 been used by any executed run in either lane before this phase?
method: regular-expression scan of 118,429 files under docs, .nisayon, artifacts, src, tests of the evaluation, execution and private-main checkouts for '"seed": 20x', 'seed-20x', 'seed=20x' and 'seed(s) 20x' with x in 0-9

prose_only: docs/evaluation/results/a1-pilot-001/pilot-acceptance.v1.json and PILOT_ACCEPTANCE.md (the predeclaration of seeds 200-209) and their retained copies inside the execution lane's packet inputs

prior_development_seeds_on_record: 51-65 and 1-50 appear only in a competitor description
result: seeds 200-209 are unexposed: no policy, replay or environment run has used them; their only appearances are the predeclaration
assignment: seeds 200-209 are assigned to the ten development episodes of this phase; after execution they are exposed to checkpoint bef2eb39 and must not serve screening (0-9) or confirmation (100-109); the next development test of any later checkpoint should use 210-219 after a fresh exposure check
